create_DMCWrapper_env: create a DMCWrapper Gym environment from a DeepMind Control Suite domain and task name
run_DMCWrapper_step: run a step on the DMCWrapper environment with a normalized action and collect reward
reset_DMCWrapper: reset the DMCWrapper environment and return the initial observation
render_DMCWrapper_rgb: render the DMCWrapper environment as an RGB array with configurable height, width, and camera
convert_spec_to_box: convert a DeepMind env observation or action spec into a Gym Box space
